title: Too expensive. Make your own!!!!!!
text: Too expensive. Make your own!!!!!!. Yes the shelf meet expectations but too expensive.  Considering what is in the package I could have just made a shelf with scrap lumber at a fraction of the cost.  Other than that the shelf is nice. Does add a little stability to the legs. Really like the traeger design that is stamped on the shelf but it won't be seen If actually using the shelf.  All in all I would not purchase again.
